column3: MT 13:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1 (vv. 5–6 together are MT 13:6). Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “answer me” is rendered “hear me,” and “sleep the death” “sleep the sleep of death.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּחַסְדְּךָ (“your steadfast love”) is rendered “Your mercy.”
